Short_Description: A full assessment and diagnosis by a psychiatrist, followed by a personalized treatment plan with medicines and guidance.
Structured one-to-one counselling at the centre to address stress, grief, relationships, and emotional wellbeing.
Evidence-based CBT and comprehensive psychological evaluations conducted by a qualified psychotherapist.
Medically supervised detoxification and long-term relapse prevention programs for alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, and prescription drug dependence.
Compassionate evaluation and treatment for ADHD, behavioural difficulties, childhood depression, and academic stress in youth.
Telemedicine consultations for patients unable to visit the clinic in person, adhering to national clinical guidelines.
